notes.body: The master won't hand over deep truths on demand, and the reason is biological: God brings us into the world as infants, not scholars. An infant can only take milk, not a steak — so knowledge has to be carried in by a gentler knowledge that goes before it. Demanding the inner realities immediately is like feeding solid meat to a newborn.
notes.quote: it must be brought in by a knowledge that goes before it

notes.body: Picture a man who steals five apples and gives them to a starving old woman as charity. He does the math in his head — fifty rewards for charity minus five sins for the theft, a net gain of forty-five. But the sixth Imam corrects the arithmetic: charity requires transferring ownership, and you cannot give away what you never owned. He earns five more sins instead of fifty rewards — ten sins, zero reward. A pious act performed without the covenant is a stolen act, and a stolen act can never be sanctified.

The covenant is the key that makes the very same act either sacred or profane — exactly like the line between fornication and marriage. Strip away the contract and the physical act is identical; it is the formal bond that places it under God's name. The same holds for meat: two animals, identical biology, but only the one slaughtered in God's name is lawful. The covenant is what places the deed under the name of Allah.
notes.anchor: the key: marriage vs fornication, halal slaughter
notes.quote: the way the distinction between unlawful union and lawful marriage opens one and shuts the other

notes.body: The fifth condition — 'do not mention me to your father' — reads at first like a cult leader isolating a recruit, but the boy's father is a known leader of a rival community that has rejected the Imam. Premature disclosure wouldn't just start a family argument; it could expose the master and cost lives. So the boy is told to stay home, honor his father, and please him outwardly while guarding the secret within — the believer's tongue kept behind his heart, speaking only when the heart judges it safe.
notes.anchor: the fifth condition and the father
notes.quote: Please him with a measure of outward agreement. Keep your secret kept and your business hidden
